Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Family's wallet-customization tray system - from the light "Wallets" grid, a "Wallet Details" tray morphs and resizes through a full customization flow (rename with keyboard, icon source menu, emoji grid, emoji color editor with Save) and contracts home, updating the wallet's identity in place.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Light "Wallets" screen: pastel card grid (pink, blue, cream, mint, gray, green), "Edit Watching" row of circular avatars (John, vitalk.eth, Marissa, BFFs), Done button. Tray states: "Wallet Details" menu (Edit Wallet, Notifications, Remove Wallet); rename state (field "Luke", Icon row, blue Save, keyboard); "Select Icon" (Use ENS Avatar, Take Photo, Choose Image, Use Emoji, Use Icon); "Choose an Emoji" (search, full emoji grid); "Use Emoji" (large emoji preview, two rows of color dots, Save). End state: grid with the customized wallet.

## Motion spec
Pattern: tray expand/contract with modal handoff.
- Tap a watched wallet: the tray rises (spring ~300/20), the grid dimming behind it (scrim 35%).
- Each deeper step: the tray's height springs to the new content (spring ~280/22, 300ms) while the old rows slide up and fade (150ms) and the new rows rise (spring ~320/18, 50ms stagger).
- The rename step pairs tray growth with the keyboard (lockstep, 250ms); the field's text caret blinks immediately.
- The emoji grid step is the tray at its tallest; picking an emoji contracts it to the color editor, the emoji flying into the preview circle (arc, 250ms).
- Color dots select with an instant ring highlight (100ms) and the preview recolors (150ms crossfade).
- Save collapses the tray step-by-step back (editor -> details, 250ms) and Done drops it fully (250ms); the wallet's circle in Edit Watching and its grid card update together (200ms crossfade).

## Calibration
- One tray surface the whole flow - steps resize it, never replace it.
- Save is always blue, always bottom-anchored, and disabled until a change exists.

## Reduced motion
Tray steps crossfade (200ms); height eases linearly (250ms).

## Don't miss
- The color dots run two rows, magenta through black; the selected dot gets a dark ring.
- The grid cards behind the tray stay parallax-still - only the scrim changes.
